title: Activities, landmarks & events in Malta
intro: A source-checked shortlist for the 13–19 October 2026 stay: confirmed event dates, ticketed activities, sights, and gaming-venue status. TWC spectator access and daily match times remain unconfirmed. Google Maps currently marks three legacy public PC/esports-centre listings as permanently closed; The Eden XP Arcade is a separate, current general arcade/VR option, not a PC LAN café. Recheck operators and live schedules before travelling.

records.name: Thunderpick World Championship 2026 Finals
records.category: Confirmed event dates — spectator access open question
records.address: BLAST Studios Malta / Malta Fairs & Conventions Centre (MFCC), Ta’ Qali, ATD 4000 Ħ’Attard
records.hours: Organizer timeline: arrivals 12 October; media day 13 October; Group Stage 14–16 October; Playoffs 17–18 October; departures 19 October 2026. Daily match times and public doors were not published on the page checked 9 October.
records.price range: Spectator access and ticket price not confirmed
records.description: The official Finals page confirms the event phases and Malta location. Thunderpick’s announcement and BLAST’s Malta fan guide corroborate BLAST Studios Malta at MFCC, Ta’ Qali. The venue identity does not establish that the event is open to the public; do not assume spectator access.
records.notes: Venue corroboration: Thunderpick announcement https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/thunderpick-world-championship-2026-returns-to-malta-with-1-million-prize-pool-302850221.html and BLAST guide https://blast.tv/cs/news/malta-fan-guide (use the latter for address corroboration only, not current spectator rules). Daily public match/door times and ticket-holder instructions remain open. The 17 October playoff date coincides with the Rolex Middle Sea Race and a Heritage Malta ticketed event; exact TWC times are not published. See getting-around.html for transport caveats once an event timetable is available.

records.name: Gżira United v Mosta FC — Malta Premier League
records.address: Tony Bezzina Stadium, Paola, Malta
records.hours: Wednesday 14 October 2026 at 19:00, as listed on the Malta FA ticket page.
records.price range: Adults €10; seniors €6; children under 16 enter free but must collect a ticket at the gate. Ticket terms may change.
records.description: The live Malta FA match-specific ticket page lists Gżira United v Mosta FC at Tony Bezzina Stadium on 14 October at 19:00. Check ticket availability and the live fixture page before travelling.
records.notes: The match-specific Malta FA page confirms date, time, stadium and ticket categories. Hibernians FC identifies Tony Bezzina Stadium as being in Paola: https://www.hiberniansfc.mt/stadium/. This direct listing resolves the earlier search-result fixture/time discrepancy; recheck before purchase.

records.name: Rolex Middle Sea Race — 2026 start
records.address: Grand Harbour, Valletta, Malta
records.hours: Saturday 17 October 2026. The Royal Malta Yacht Club’s 2 October article confirms the date and harbour but does not give the exact start time.
records.price range: No spectator ticket or viewing fee was stated in the organizer article
records.description: The 47th Rolex Middle Sea Race starts from Grand Harbour during the trip. The organizer describes a fleet of more than 100 yachts. The precise start time was not published in the official article checked 9 October, so do not build a timed connection around an estimated start.
records.notes: RMYC identifies viewing locations in the separate ‘Race-start viewpoints’ card below. The same article mentions English commentary on RMYC / Rolex Middle Sea Race social channels and Maltese commentary on TVMSport+; that is not evidence of AM/FM/DAB radio carriage. Radio research belongs on radio.html.

records.name: Picnic in the 1800s — Borġ in-Nadur
records.category: Official event listing — site access conflict
records.address: Borġ in-Nadur Prehistoric Complex, Sqaq In-Nadur, Birżebbuġa, Malta
records.hours: The event page lists Saturday 17 October 2026, 13:00–16:00, with arrival by 12:45. However, Heritage Malta’s general opening-hours notice checked 9 October says Borġ in-Nadur is closed to visitors due to road works until further notice; event access/status needs direct confirmation.
records.price range: The event page lists €55 per adult, senior, student or child; €45 for Heritage Malta members. Do not assume tickets are available or that the event can proceed while the closure notice is active.
records.description: Heritage Malta’s dedicated page advertises this ticketed afternoon-tea event, but its current site-wide notice separately says Borġ in-Nadur is closed to visitors due to road works. Treat the event as listed but not fully confirmed for access or delivery until the organizer clarifies the conflict.
records.notes: The dedicated event page gives the schedule, arrival instruction, description and listed prices: https://heritagemalta.mt/whats-on/picnic-in-the-1800s/. The separate current Heritage Malta opening-hours page says: ‘due to road works, Borġ in-Nadur Prehistoric Complex will be closed to visitors until further notice’: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. Contact Heritage Malta and confirm the event is proceeding and the site is accessible before travelling or budgeting it as committed. It also coincides with TWC Playoffs and the Rolex Middle Sea Race start; their exact times are not published.

records.name: In Guardia — Fort St Elmo re-enactment
records.address: Fort St Elmo and the National War Museum, Mediterranean Street, Valletta, Malta
records.hours: Sunday 18 October 2026. Entry opens at 10:00; the re-enactment runs 11:00–12:00; the National War Museum opens at 12:00. The show may be cancelled for adverse weather.
records.price range: In Guardia only: adults €10, seniors/students €7.50, children €5, infants free. Show plus Fort and National War Museum: adults €17, seniors/students €13, children €9, infants free.
records.description: Heritage Malta lists an In Guardia historical re-enactment on Sunday 18 October. The event ticket is separate from ordinary museum entry; advance booking is available through the official page.
records.notes: Heritage Malta says HM Passports and discount cards do not apply to these event tickets, and that the event can be cancelled for adverse weather. The same page lists the 2026 date and both ticket types.

records.name: Rolex Middle Sea Race — organizer-listed viewing areas
records.address: Upper Barrakka Gardens and waterfronts of Valletta, Senglea and Vittoriosa
records.hours: For the race start on Saturday 17 October 2026; exact start time and location-specific access arrangements were not stated by the organizer.
records.price range: No viewing fee was stated; this is not a ticket for the Saluting Battery or other attractions
records.description: The Royal Malta Yacht Club names Upper Barrakka Gardens and the waterfronts of Valletta, Senglea and Vittoriosa as the best places to watch the start. Crowd levels, garden access and the exact race time still need a live check.
records.notes: Organizer source confirms suggested viewing areas, not reserved access, a viewing platform, or a timetable. Do not assume Saluting Battery entry is free or included; it is a separate managed attraction. Recheck local access and transport notices on the day.

records.name: The Gamers Lounge — PC café status conflict
records.address: John Borg Street, Msida MSD 1201, Malta
records.hours: The operator’s contact page lists store hours Mon–Fri 10:00–19:00, Sat 10:00–13:00, Sun closed. These do not confirm PC-session availability; Google Maps marks its place listing permanently closed as checked 9 October.
records.price range: Current PC-session rates not verified; an older operator outlet page described timed sessions but did not provide a current, directly retrievable price list.
records.description: The operator’s current website still describes The Gamers Lounge as a PC-gaming lounge and hardware retailer in Msida, but Google Maps labels the named place permanently closed. Treat the public gaming café status as unresolved and call before making a trip; this is not a confirmed open walk-in venue.
records.notes: Operator pages: https://gamerslounge.mt/faqs and https://gamerslounge.mt/contact-us (the FAQ calls it a gaming lounge; contact page lists retail hours and location). Google Maps status is a platform report, not an operator closure notice. An older Reddit discussion from 2021 is ambiguous about walk-in play and is not current evidence: https://www.reddit.com/r/malta/comments/q5vylk/gaming_places_in_malta/. The operator’s old outlet page could not be fetched directly.

records.name: Esports Plaza Gaming Lounge — closure reported
records.address: Level 0, The Plaza Shopping Centre, Bisazza Street, Sliema SLM 1640, Malta
records.hours: No current hours verified. Google Maps marked the place permanently closed on 9 October 2026; a third-party directory still displays hours that may be stale.
records.price range: No current price verified
records.description: This was listed as a PC/console gaming lounge at The Plaza. Google Maps currently reports it permanently closed; the older Plaza page returns 404 and esportsplaza.com.mt returned a 503 error when checked. Do not plan a visit unless the operator confirms it has reopened.
records.notes: The directly fetched Google Maps listing showed 4.5/125 and ‘permanently closed’ (rating is a dated listing snapshot, not a recommendation). Hopsa’s directory still lists address, phone and hours but is not the operator: https://hopsa.io/en/attractions/malta,jedzenie-picie,esports-plaza-gaming-lounge-69cf83a22b. The Plaza’s old Esports page returned 404 and the venue domain returned 503.

records.name: Eden Esports Centre — legacy walk-in listing
records.address: SuperBowl, Triq Santu Wistin, St Julian’s, Malta
records.hours: No walk-in hours verified. Google Maps marked Eden Esports Centre permanently closed on 9 October 2026.
records.price range: No current drop-in gaming price verified
records.description: A former PC/esports-centre listing at SuperBowl. Google Maps reports it permanently closed. Eden’s current official material describes a team bootcamp by arrangement, not a public drop-in PC café; see the separate, currently listed XP Arcade entry below for general games.
records.notes: Google Maps listing showed 4.1/15 and ‘permanently closed’ (a dated user-generated listing). Eden’s current bootcamp article describes a team facility at InterContinental Malta tied to a qualifying accommodation booking, not public walk-in access: https://theeden.mt/inside-eden-esports-premium-bootcamp-experience-in-malta/.

records.name: The Eden — XP Arcade, VR and games
records.address: Triq Santu Wistin, St Julian’s STJ 3310, Malta
records.hours: The Eden’s contact page labels these ‘Winter opening hours’: Mon–Wed 11:00–00:00; Thu–Fri 11:00–01:00; Sat 10:00–01:00; Sun 10:00–00:00. It does not state when the winter schedule begins; confirm it covers 13–19 October.
records.price range: XP Arcade credit packs listed: 90 credits €10; 260 credits €20; 650 credits €50; 1,500 credits €100. Individual game-credit costs vary.
records.description: A current general entertainment venue with arcade, VR/video games, racing games and prize redemption. The operator’s XP Arcade page labels the experience ‘For All Ages’. This is an arcade/social-gaming option, not a dedicated public PC esports lounge.
records.notes: Credit packs and activity type are listed by the operator. Address, phone +356 2371 0450 and seasonal hours: https://theeden.mt/contact-us. Google Maps currently lists The Eden as open, but its hours are a live listing snapshot; see https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=The+Eden+Triq+Santu+Wistin+St+Julian%27s+Malta.

records.name: Malta National Aquarium
records.address: Qawra Point, Triq it-Trunciera, Qawra, Malta
records.hours: The current official homepage shows daily opening 10:00–20:00. The current site page checked did not display a last-entry cutoff; confirm before a late visit.
records.price range: Online / door: adult (13+) €16.90 / €17.90; child (4–12) €10.90 / €11.90; senior (60+) €13.90 / €14.90. After-16:00 online tickets are separately priced; see the live ticket page.
records.description: An indoor marine-life attraction in Qawra with a walk-through main-tank tunnel and a changing schedule of talks. The operator’s live ticket page lists online discounts and the current ticket categories.
records.notes: Hours, current location and daily programme are on the operator homepage https://aquarium.com.mt/. The legacy www.aquarium.com.mt listing says last entry 19:30, but the current site view did not surface that cutoff; verify directly if arriving late. TripAdvisor snapshot 9 Oct: 4.0/5 from 4,937 reviews, #4 of 7 things to do in Qawra; recent reviews include both praise for marine exhibits and mixed views on visit length/value. https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g608947-d4753782-Reviews-Malta_National_Aquarium-Qawra_Island_of_Malta.html. Ratings and reviews are volatile and subjective.

records.name: Comino — Blue Lagoon day trip
records.address: Blue Lagoon, Comino, Malta
records.hours: A free landing QR pass is required before stepping ashore in the Blue Lagoon area. Listed slots: 08:00–13:00, 13:30–17:30 and 18:00–22:00. Ferry times are separate and operator-specific.
records.price range: Blue Lagoon landing pass: free. Ferry/boat fare is separate and varies by operator; no trip-specific fare was verified.
records.description: A possible island day trip, subject to the boat operator’s 13–19 October timetable, weather and capacity. The official Blue Lagoon Access Management System says visitors need a free timed QR landing pass to remain ashore in the Lagoon; it is not a ferry ticket.
records.notes: The official AMS FAQ says passes can be booked up to two months ahead, ferry transport must be purchased separately, and authorised-vessel/operator rules apply. Malta’s official tourism ferry directory lists a Paradise Diving service from Ċirkewwa every 30 minutes from 1 May to 31 October, but that directory is not a date-specific sailing confirmation: https://www.visitmalta.com/en/a/ferries-and-water-taxis/. Check the chosen operator and Blue Lagoon booking portal for your exact day.

records.name: Ta’ Qali Artisan Village
records.address: Ta’ Qali Artisan Village, Ta’ Qali, Attard ATD 4000, Malta
records.hours: Not published on the official village pages checked. Individual artisans may have different schedules; contact the village before making a special trip.
records.price range: No general admission price published; individual artisan products are priced by each shop.
records.description: The official village describes opportunities to watch local craftspeople at work, including glassblowing, filigree, jewellery, ceramics, wood, metal and stonework. It is a Ta’ Qali-area cultural stop, but exact opening/working hours were not published.
records.notes: Official homepage overview: https://artisanvillagesmalta.com/. Contact listed by the operator: +356 2226 4400, artisanvillage@indismalta.com. Confirm which studios are open on your chosen day; the village’s general information does not guarantee live demonstrations.

records.name: Mdina and Rabat historic-centre walk
records.address: Mdina and Rabat, Malta
records.hours: No general city-walk hours published by the tourism overview; churches, museums and ticketed sites set their own hours.
records.price range: No general admission price stated for the town walk; individual sites may charge separately.
records.description: Visit Malta presents Mdina as Malta’s old capital and a historic fortified city, with Rabat beside it and additional archaeological and religious sites. This is an undated outdoor sightseeing suggestion, not a date-specific event or a promise that every museum will be open.
records.notes: The official page’s text did not fully render in the page parser; its search-indexed description identifies Mdina as the old capital and highlights its fortified history. For a ticketed nearby stop, Heritage Malta’s St Paul’s Catacombs page is separately listed below.

records.name: St John’s Co-Cathedral
records.address: St John’s Square, Valletta VLT 1156, Malta
records.hours: Monday–Saturday 09:00–16:45; last admission 16:00. Closed Sundays and public holidays, as listed by the operator.
records.price range: Adults €15; seniors/students €12; children under 12 free when accompanied by an adult. Optional belfry tour €5; admission fee applies.
records.description: A major Valletta church visit with a handheld multilingual audio guide included in admission. Dress appropriately; the operator recommends around 1 hour 45 minutes. The church is open on the listed weekdays, but its Museum is currently stated to be closed for extension/refurbishment.
records.notes: The official visit page confirms hours, admission and dress/access guidance. It currently displays a notice that the Museum is closed for extension and refurbishment; this does not itself confirm a closure of the Co-Cathedral. Check for any trip-week service or special-closure notice before going.

records.name: Grand Master’s Palace and Armoury
records.address: St George’s Square, Valletta, Malta
records.hours: 10:00–18:00 daily under Heritage Malta’s 1 March–31 October 2026 summer schedule; last admission 30 minutes before closing.
records.price range: Adults €12; ages 12–17 and seniors 60+ €10; ages 6–11 €8; ages 1–5 free. Heritage Malta members/passport holders free.
records.description: A historic palace and state-building with restored State Rooms and the Palace Armoury. Heritage Malta says the Throne Room remains closed to the public; other state-function closures can occur.
records.notes: The official 2026 summer-hours chart gives 10:00–18:00 daily through 31 October, with last admission 30 minutes before close: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. The listed State Rooms closures are on 26 and 28 October, 18 November and 2 December, outside the requested 13–19 October window; the Throne Room remains closed until further notice. Rare state functions may cause additional closure.

records.name: National Museum of Archaeology
records.address: Auberge de Provence, Republic Street, Valletta, Malta
records.hours: 09:00–19:00 daily under Heritage Malta’s 1 March–31 October 2026 summer schedule; last admission 30 minutes before closing.
records.price range: Adults €5; ages 12–17, seniors 60+, concessions/students €3.50; ages 6–11 €2.50; ages 1–5 free. Heritage Malta members/passport holders free.
records.description: A Valletta museum covering Maltese prehistory through the early Phoenician period, with objects such as the Sleeping Lady, Venus of Malta and the Cippus. The current operator page includes multilingual audio guides and accessibility information.
records.notes: The official Heritage Malta hours chart gives 09:00–19:00 daily through 31 October 2026; last admission is 30 minutes before close: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. Recheck the operator notice for changes before travel.

records.name: Fort St Elmo and the National War Museum
records.address: Mediterranean Street, Valletta, Malta
records.hours: 09:00–19:00 daily under Heritage Malta’s 1 March–31 October 2026 summer schedule; last admission 30 minutes before closing. On scheduled In Guardia Sundays, event entry begins at 10:00 and ordinary admission begins at 12:00.
records.price range: Adults €10; seniors 60+, ages 12–17 and concessions/students €7.50; ages 6–11 €5.50; ages 1–5 free. Heritage Malta members/passport holders free. Separate In Guardia tickets are listed above.
records.description: A large Valletta fort and museum spanning Maltese military history. Heritage Malta’s current notice says the WWI display in Section 4 is closed until further notice; Section 2 covering the early Knights and Great Siege is available again from 1 August.
records.notes: Heritage Malta’s summer-hours chart gives 09:00–19:00 daily through 31 October, last admission 30 minutes before close: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. On Sunday 18 October, In Guardia is separately scheduled for 11:00–12:00; the show and ordinary museum entry have different ticket rules. See https://heritagemalta.mt/whats-on/in-guardia-fort-st-elmo-and-the-national-war-museum-2/.

records.name: St Paul’s Catacombs
records.address: Triq Ħal-Bajjada, Rabat, Malta
records.hours: Heritage Malta’s 2026 summer schedule lists 09:00–19:00 daily through 31 October, with last admission 30 minutes before close. A Google Maps snapshot checked 9 October instead lists Friday 09:00–17:00; confirm with Heritage Malta before visiting.
records.price range: Adults €6; ages 12–17, seniors 60+, concessions/students €4.50; ages 6–11 €3.50; ages 1–5 free. Heritage Malta members/passport holders free.
records.description: A large interconnected underground burial complex from Punic, Roman and Byzantine periods. Heritage Malta describes it as the earliest and largest archaeological evidence of Christianity in Malta; audio guides are available. The site has partial accessibility, narrow passages and stairs.
records.notes: The official summer-hours chart and general notice give 09:00–19:00 daily through 31 October and last admission 30 minutes before close: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. The direct Google Maps listing snapshot instead displays Friday 09:00–17:00 and rating 4.3: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=St+Paul%27s+Catacombs+Rabat+Malta. Prefer the official seasonal schedule provisionally, but confirm this discrepancy with Heritage Malta before travel. TripAdvisor snapshot checked 9 Oct: 4.1/5 from 1,686 reviews, #3 of 48 things to do in Rabat; recent feedback mentions crowding and narrow/stepped spaces: https://www.tripadvisor.com/Attraction_Review-g190326-d2624344-Reviews-St_Paul_s_Catacombs-Rabat_Island_of_Malta.html. Ratings/reviews are subjective and accessibility details should be checked against the official access statement.

records.name: Ħaġar Qim and Mnajdra Archaeological Park
records.address: Triq Ħaġar Qim, Qrendi, Malta
records.hours: 09:00–19:00 daily under Heritage Malta’s 1 March–31 October 2026 summer schedule; last admission 30 minutes before closing.
records.price range: Adults €10; ages 12–17, seniors 60+, concessions/students €7.50; ages 6–11 €5.50; ages 1–5 free. Heritage Malta members/passport holders free.
records.description: Two megalithic temple sites dating to the late Neolithic, more than 5,000 years old and part of the UNESCO-listed Megalithic Temples of Malta. The sites are about 500 metres apart; the walk to Mnajdra is downhill and Mnajdra is not accessible to visitors with mobility limitations.
records.notes: Heritage Malta’s summer-hours chart gives 09:00–19:00 daily through 31 October, last admission 30 minutes before close: https://heritagemalta.mt/opening-hours/. The operator says the Visitor Centre and Ħaġar Qim are accessible (assistance may still be needed), while Mnajdra is not. Check the access statement and transport before planning.
